title: KronosToolpath
description: JSON Schema for the MEDUSA→KRONOS toolpath export format. Version 1.0.0 (SemVer). All positions in mm, velocities in mm/s.

schema_version.description: SemVer version of this schema. KRONOS must verify that the major part matches.

slicer_version.description: SemVer version of the MEDUSA slicer that produced this job.

algorithm.description: Slicing algorithm used to generate this toolpath.

units.description: Units of measurement for position and time values.

reference_frame.description: Name of the reference coordinate frame (TF2 frame in ROS 2).

created_at.description: Timestamp at which the job was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

waypoints_hash.description: FNV-1a-64 checksum (16 lowercase hex digits) computed over the serialised 'waypoints' array. Used for integrity verification.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of 6-DOF path points in execution order.

x.description: X coordinate in the reference frame [mm].

y.description: Y coordinate in the reference frame [mm].

z.description: Z coordinate in the reference frame [mm].

qw.description: Quaternion real part w. The quaternion must be normalised (|q| = 1).

extrusion.description: Extrusion flow rate [mm³/s]. Must be 0 for travel moves.

motion_type.description: Type of motion: 'travel' (no material deposition) or 'print' (active extrusion).

layer_id.description: Layer index (0-based). May be equal across consecutive waypoints, but must be monotonically non-decreasing.

branch_id.description: Branch identifier from the Crystal branch tracker. 0 = trunk / planar base; 1..N = tracked branches. Optional; defaults to 0 for legacy / non-Crystal exports.
